question.text: The solution of the differential equation <math><mi>x</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">sin</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>y</mi><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mrow><mrow><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">sin</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow></mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></math> is (where, <math><mi>c</mi></math> is an arbitrary constant)

options.text: <math><mi>x</mi><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">tan</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>-</mo><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">ln</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">sec</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mrow><mo>=</mo><mi>y</mi><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">tan</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow></mrow><mo>-</mo><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">ln</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">sec</mi></mrow><mo>⁡</mo><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow></mrow></mrow></mfenced></mrow></mrow><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></math>

solution.text:
The given equation is xcos2⁡ydx=ycos2⁡xdy

∫xsec2⁡xdx=∫ysec2⁡ydy

Using integration by parts, we get,

xtan⁡x-ln⁡sec⁡x=ytan⁡y-ln⁡sec⁡y+c
